prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create a SECOND VARIANT of the existing fictional floating memory-mask companion shown in the input atlas, for player two in the same adventure game. Image1 is the design, pixel-art finish, animation-registration and layout reference. Keep the EXACT same deliberate pixel-art style: chunky square color clusters, crisp stepped dark outlines, carved wood facets, expressive almond eyes and geometric bead decoration. No painterly smoothing, gradients, blur, 3D render or labels.
The second mask must be recognizable as a distinct companion, not just an identical copy: a slightly broader oval-to-diamond face in deep indigo and teal painted wood with warm walnut edges, antique silver/bronze trim, two symmetric small carved cheek ridges, cream dotted face markings and diamond/chevron motifs. Bright AMBER eyes, an oval emerald jewel on its forehead, compact golden mouth. Five vivid feather plumes in blue, turquoise, emerald, violet and a single warm gold accent, arranged with a taller central turquoise plume. Circular silver-bronze side hoops. Same friendly wise fantasy personality and approximately the same full feather-to-chin height and thickness as player one's red/gold mask. Fictional original fantasy art, no claim to a specific real deity or ceremonial tradition.
Production sprite sheet EXACTLY 4 equal COLUMNS by 8 equal ROWS, 32 frames, tall 1:2 aspect ratio. Every cell contains the same complete second-mask design, stable center, scale and registration. Fully show all feathers and hoops, with at least 12 percent clear alpha padding inside EVERY cell.
Row1 FRONT idle blink: open, half closed, closed, reopening.
Row2 LEFT three-quarter: same four blink phases.
Row3 RIGHT three-quarter: same four blink phases.
Row4 FRONT magical investigation activation: normal, jewel/eyes brighter, strongest amber/emerald inner glow, settle; restrained light within the details, no big glow cloud.
Row5 FRONT speaking: lips apart, small open mouth, rounded mouth, nearly closed.
Row6 FRONT curious: raised eyebrow, glance left, glance right, relaxed.
Row7 FRONT surprised: eyes widen, small O mouth, recovery, settle.
Row8 FRONT happy: gentle smile, bigger smile, happy closed eyes, relaxed smile.
Genuine transparent RGBA alpha=0 between sprites and in all corners. NO black, white or colored backdrop, no checkerboard, tiles, cast shadows, text, numbers, symbols outside the mask, grid, watermark or scene. Preserve sharp visible pixel steps at game scale.
